target.consumer: stale/recovery scanner and recursive generation workers

title: Propagate attributable child progress into parent liveness
problem: The live GEN2 end-to-end parent RUN still reports heartbeat_at=10:01:50 and only CLAIMED/STARTED checkpoints while its declared canary subtree contains child RETURN evidence at 10:09:49 and later. A stale detector that only sees the parent RUN can therefore classify a recursively active parent as stale even though attributable child work is durably progressing. Repository activity itself must not be treated as liveness; the missing piece is explicit parent-child progress lineage.
mission: Add a bounded, reconstructable parent-child progress signal for recursive/multi-stage opportunities so attributable child lifecycle evidence can prevent false stale recovery without allowing unrelated commits, bare recovery attempts or endlessly spawning descendants to keep a dead parent alive.
acceptance: Every child lifecycle artifact that is allowed to extend parent liveness carries or resolves an explicit parent_run_ref and parent_progress_class.

The stale scanner computes latest attributable progress from the parent heartbeat/checkpoint plus explicitly linked child STARTED/CHECKPOINT/RETURN signals, never from arbitrary repository commit time.
A bare recovery-attempt/claim artifact does not count as worker progress unless the recovery protocol separately authorizes that signal class.
Child-derived liveness is bounded: a parent cannot stay active indefinitely from descendant creation alone; terminal child evidence or periodic bounded parent checkpoints are required.
Late parent/child returns remain append-only and reconcilable; child liveness evidence never grants promotion or shared write authority.
A canary with an old parent heartbeat and a fresh explicitly linked child RETURN remains non-recoverable until the child-derived signal itself crosses the stale threshold.
A control canary with unrelated fresh commits but no linked child progress remains recoverable when its real parent signals are stale.

observed_live_evidence.finding: Durable child progress is newer than the parent liveness fields, but the current parent RUN does not expose that progress as a reconstructable liveness edge.

value_signals.goal_relevance: Recursive Planner/GEN2 work is a current compounding gate; false takeover can duplicate or corrupt exactly the long-running multi-stage work the canary is trying to prove.
value_signals.unblock_value: Makes stale recovery compatible with recursive children rather than forcing workers to manually refresh parent heartbeat during every child phase.
value_signals.information_gain: Separates genuine attributable progress from arbitrary repository churn and from recovery-attempt noise.
value_signals.human_friction_reduction: Workers can survive chat/runtime timing boundaries without the human deciding whether an apparently stale recursive parent is actually alive.

risk.main: Treating descendant activity too broadly as parent liveness could hide dead parents indefinitely or let unrelated repository churn suppress recovery.
risk.mitigation: Require explicit parent_run_ref attribution, an allowlisted progress class and bounded lease-extension semantics; never infer liveness from path/commit recency alone.

falsification: A parent with an old heartbeat is recovered even though a newer explicitly linked child RETURN is within the active threshold.
An unrelated commit under the repository refreshes a stale parent's liveness.
A bare recovery claim with no substantive STARTED/checkpoint proof keeps a dead parent alive.
Repeated child creation can extend a parent lease forever without terminal progress or bounded checkpoints.
Parent-child progress lineage cannot be reconstructed from durable refs after the originating chat disappears.
dedup_note: This is distinct from P-1c64c0e1e704-recovery-race-v1, which elects one writer after concurrent recovery contenders appear, and from the existing critic F4 about recovery attempts incorrectly counting as liveness. This proposal addresses the opposite false-negative: real subordinate work is occurring, but its attributable progress is not represented in the parent liveness model.

source_freshness.note: Evidence was re-fetched from live main immediately before proposal pinning; the repository was advancing concurrently.
